title: The Wolf of the Weeping Wood
author: Edmund Iversen
blurb: Hazel Quintana, a bone-carver who hears the dead, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
